title: TodoMVC: the official JavaScript ES6 implementation, judged by the jQuery app’s recordings

rewrite.label: JavaScript ES6 (official)
rewrite.framework: Official TodoMVC JavaScript ES6 example (tastejs/todomvc, commit ff43b02)

agent.portPrompt: Port the legacy TodoMVC app in {legacyDir} (jQuery + Handlebars) to React 19 + TypeScript, built with Vite, in the current directory. Keep the same look (reuse its CSS) and the same behaviour, so users don't notice the switch. Set Vite's base to './' so `npm run build` writes a static site to dist/. Don't add features. Finish when `npm install` and `npm run build` succeed.

note: Not written by an agent: the official JavaScript ES6 TodoMVC from tastejs/todomvc (commit ff43b02), checked with the 18 recordings Kane made on the jQuery app. Both differences are one bug nobody had reported: clicking the mark-all checkbox itself completes nothing (the build listens on its label). Kane missed the reported one (#2311, new todos go to the top): its recorded check finds the new todo by its text, so the replay audit had Kane run that test fresh, and the original sentence passed again.
